description:
Benchmark constructors accept parameters that are unreachable from the CLI. The orchestrator (_get_benchmark_instance) only forwards a fixed set of kwargs (scale_factor, compress_data, compression_type, compression_level, verbose, quiet, parallel). Benchmark-specific parameters like taxi_types, year, months, end_year, num_hosts, skew_preset, dimensions, hash_algorithm, seed, and force_regenerate never reach the constructor.
This affects 10 of 21 benchmarks. The fix is a --benchmark-option K=V mechanism mirroring the existing --platform-option K=V pattern. Each benchmark registers typed option specs; the orchestrator merges parsed options into constructor kwargs.

anti_patterns.dont: add individual CLI flags per benchmark parameter (--taxi-types, --year, --end-year)
anti_patterns.instead: use the generic --benchmark-option K=V mechanism instead
anti_patterns.why: this creates N*M option explosion across 21 benchmarks and 30+ existing CLI options
platform and benchmark options have different lifecycles (platform options go to DatabaseConfig, benchmark options go to constructor kwargs)

anti_patterns.dont: pass raw BenchmarkConfig.options dict as **kwargs to constructors
anti_patterns.instead: only forward keys that have registered BenchmarkOptionSpecs
anti_patterns.why: options contains orchestrator-level settings (tuning_enabled, validation flags, estimated_time_range) that would cause TypeError on benchmark constructors

anti_patterns.dont: use Python inspect/reflection to auto-discover constructor params
anti_patterns.instead: use explicit spec registration per benchmark (same as platform-option)
anti_patterns.why: it's fragile across **kwargs, defaults, and type annotations

deferrals.reason: Tab-completion for --benchmark-option keys and choices would improve DX but requires Click shell completion integration. Not needed for initial release.
Could catch mismatches between registered spec names and actual constructor param names. Low risk since specs are co-located with benchmark code and tested. Adds import-time overhead.
deferrals.summary: Validate benchmark options against constructor signature at registration time

preserves.behavior: All existing benchmark default behavior unchanged when no --benchmark-option provided
BenchmarkConfig.options continues serving its existing purposes (tuning config, validation flags, power run settings)
Benchmarks with only standard params (tpch, tpcds, ssb, clickbench, h2odb, etc.) unaffected
seed and force_regenerate continue working in their current RunConfig/orchestrator paths - benchmark-option adds a parallel path to the constructor

verifications.description: NYC Taxi benchmark accepts taxi_types via CLI
verifications.expected: dry run shows 3 taxi types, 39 queries

work_units.notes:
Mirror platform_hooks.py structure: - BenchmarkOptionError (ValueError subclass) - BenchmarkOptionSpec dataclass (name, parser, default, help, choices, aliases) - List/enum parser functions: parse_int_list, parse_str_list, parse_enum_list factory - BenchmarkHookRegistry class: register_option_specs(benchmark, *specs),
  parse_options(benchmark, provided), describe_options(benchmark), get_default_options(benchmark)
- Reuse existing parse_bool and _identity from platform_hooks or extract to shared utils
work_units.summary: Create BenchmarkHookRegistry and BenchmarkOptionSpec in benchbox/cli/benchmark_hooks.py

work_units.notes:
In benchbox/cli/commands/run.py: - Add BenchmarkOptionParamType (same pattern as PlatformOptionParamType) - Add @click.option("--benchmark-option", ..., type=BenchmarkOptionParamType(),
  multiple=True, hidden=True) - parallel to --platform-option
- Parse benchmark options via BenchmarkHookRegistry.parse_options(benchmark, pairs) - Store parsed options in BenchmarkConfig.options under a namespaced key
  (e.g., options["benchmark_options"] = {...}) to avoid collision with existing options
work_units.summary: Add --benchmark-option Click option to run.py and wire parsing

work_units.notes:
In benchbox/cli/orchestrator.py _get_benchmark_instance(): - Extract benchmark_options from config.options.get("benchmark_options", {}) - Merge into kwargs dict before calling benchmark_class(**kwargs) - seed and force_regenerate: these already live in BenchmarkConfig.options
  but are NOT forwarded to constructors today. The orchestrator should check
  if the current benchmark has registered BenchmarkOptionSpecs for "seed" or
  "force_regenerate" (via BenchmarkHookRegistry.list_option_specs(benchmark)),
  and if so, include them in kwargs from config.options. Benchmarks that don't
  register these specs simply never receive them (no change). This avoids a
  dual-path where seed flows through both config.options and --benchmark-option.
- Preserve existing try/except TypeError fallback for parallel param
work_units.summary: Wire orchestrator to forward benchmark options to constructor kwargs

work_units.notes:
These benchmarks require the custom parser functions built in w1 (parse_enum_list, parse_int_list, parse_datetime). This is the highest-risk work unit - validate parser edge cases (empty lists, single values, whitespace) here before w5.
NYC Taxi (benchbox/core/nyctaxi/benchmark.py): - taxi_types: parse_enum_list(TaxiType), default=None, choices description - year: int parser, default=2019, choices=range(2019,2026) - months: parse_int_list, default=None - seed: int parser, default=None
TSBS DevOps (benchbox/core/tsbs_devops/benchmark.py): - num_hosts: int parser, default=None - duration_days: int parser, default=None - interval_seconds: int parser, default=10 - start_time: parse_datetime, default=None
Registration via module-level BenchmarkHookRegistry.register_option_specs() calls (same pattern as platform option registration in benchbox/platforms/__init__.py).
work_units.summary: Register option specs for high-complexity benchmarks (NYC Taxi, TSBS DevOps - enum lists, datetime, int lists)

work_units.notes:
These benchmarks use only str, int, parse_bool, parse_str_list, and choices-constrained str parsers - all straightforward. Lower risk than w4.
FlightData: end_year (int, default=LAST_AVAILABLE_YEAR) DataVault: hash_algorithm (str, choices=["md5","sha256",...]), record_source (str) TPC-DS OBT: tpcds_source_dir (str), dimension_mode (str, choices), channels (parse_str_list), output_format (str, choices) TPC-H Skew: skew_preset (str, choices=["none","light","moderate","heavy","extreme","realistic"]) Vector Search: dimensions (int, default=128) Join Order: queries_dir (str) TPC-DI: enable_parallel (parse_bool, default=False), max_workers (int)
work_units.summary: Register option specs for simple-type benchmarks (FlightData, DataVault, TPC-DS OBT, TPC-H Skew, Vector Search, Join Order, TPC-DI)

work_units.notes: tests/unit/cli/test_benchmark_hooks.py: - Registry: register, parse, describe, defaults, unknown key rejection, duplicate rejection - Parsers: parse_int_list, parse_str_list, parse_enum_list (TaxiType), parse_datetime - Integration: BenchmarkOptionParamType Click type, end-to-end from CLI string to constructor kwarg - Regression: benchmarks without registered specs still construct normally
work_units.summary: Add unit tests for BenchmarkHookRegistry, parsers, and end-to-end wiring
